thread:
incident-bot: SEV2 -> eu-inference-host high 5xx spike (service: generation). Pager: @dylan. Impact: ~2% errors, latency + tail. Auto-fallback to smaller model triggered for some routes.

dylan: oncall here, looking. can someone post quick repro or logs?

maya: grabbing logs and tailing the host now. seeing KV cache evicts around 12:03 UTC, repeated OOM-ish GC spikes.

rafael: saw similar last week but on a different pool. sharing quick query: `journalctl -u runner | grep -i "evict" -n` -> lots of evict cycles.

liz: customer impact update: search-prod errors spiking at 12:05, roughly 18% of user requests for the search-rewrite route. not global but high-traffic.

carla: mitigation suggestion: temporarily raise KV cache TTL and drop batch size for generation-route to reduce mem pressure. can do TL;DR config patch.

ops-bot: deploy-started by dylan: patch kv_cache.ttl=30m and route.batch_size=8 -> deploy id dep-7629 at 12:18 UTC

dylan: patch applied, monitoring. also enabled fallback to model-quant-small for non-critical routes.

maya: errors falling back to baseline. 5xx down to 0.3% at 12:27. latency returning to normal. good stopgap.

dylan: good. we'll keep this as a live mitigation. handoff to post-incident review for root cause and proper fix.

sam-pm: scheduling postmortem — prefer tomorrow 1400 UTC or Wed 1030 UTC. agenda: timeline, RCA, action items (owner + size + priority), customer comms. who can own?

rafael: I can own RCA with maya. estimate: 6-10h investigation (size: M).

maya: will join RCA. action item: investigate KV eviction pattern and worst-case memory amplification. estimate: 8h (size: M). owner: maya/rafael. priority: P0 for infra stability, tie to Q2 reliability OKR.

liz: customer follow-up: draft credit/notice for affected tenants. owner: sam-pm. estimate: 2h (size: S). priority: P1.

carla: remediation item: add circuit-breaker for model fallback to avoid flipping fallbacks too aggressively. estimate: 16-24h (size: L). owner: carla. target sprint: next sprint. priority: P0.

dylan: infra fix: tune cache eviction thresholds and add metrics + alerting. estimate: 12h (size: M). owner: dylan. priority: P0.

sam-pm: ok capture all items in a follow-up ticket list. prefer triage sheet with columns: ticket, owner, size(S/M/L), ETA (date), priority, sprint. we'll sync in postmortem.

ops-bot: postmortem draft created: PM-1245, link: https://redwood.company/pm/PM-1245 (auto).

dylan: temporary note for postmortem: include cost delta from fallback model (we saw +15% token cost during mitigation). owner: finance contact? cc @liz.

liz: noted, will pull cost delta + customer impact numbers. estimate 3h (size: S). owner: liz.

rafael: for sizing clarity: M=~1 dev day, L=2-3 dev days, S=few hours.

sam-pm: agreed. booking postmortem for tomorrow 14:00 UTC. attendees: dylan, maya, rafael, carla, liz, eng-platform lead optional. If anything changes, update PM-1245.

dylan: handing off monitoring for next 12h to @maya. leaving page channel. thanks all. :thumbsup:

maya: taking watch. logging action items into PM-1245 now. will post an updates thread after RCA.

incident-bot: SEV2 -> incident resolved (mitigation in place). duration: ~25m.

carla: quick ops note for postmortem: include retrospective on rollout gating for quantized models; might be related.

sam-pm: adding that to agenda. closing thread for live mitigation; move detailed RCA to PM-1245 and postmortem doc.
